Heart-Shaped Chocolate Truffles

Served at: Saint Valentine's Day

Makes about 24 trufflesPrep 30 minCook 10 min

Heart-Shaped Chocolate Truffles are a classic treat for Saint Valentine's Day, symbolizing love and affection. These rich, creamy confections are perfect for gifting or sharing with a loved one on this romantic holiday.

Ingredients

  • 8 oz (225 g) bittersweet chocolate, finely chopped
  • 1/2 cup (120 ml) heavy cream
  • 2 tbsp (30 g) unsalted butter, softened
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • 1/4 tsp salt
  • 1 cup (100 g) cocoa powder, for coating
  • Optional: red or pink sanding sugar or edible glitter for decoration

Method

  1. Place the chopped bittersweet chocolate in a heatproof bowl.
  2. Heat the heavy cream in a small saucepan over medium heat until it just begins to simmer.
  3. Pour the hot cream over the chopped chocolate and let sit for 2 minutes to melt.
  4. Add the softened butter, vanilla extract, and salt to the chocolate mixture.
  5. Stir gently until the mixture is smooth and glossy.
  6. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or until firm.
  7. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  8. Using a small spoon or melon baller, scoop out the chilled chocolate mixture and quickly shape into small balls.
  9. Roll each ball in cocoa powder to coat evenly.
  10. Optional: Press each truffle gently into heart-shaped silicone molds or use a small heart-shaped cookie cutter to shape while the mixture is slightly softened.
  11. Place the shaped truffles on the parchment-lined baking sheet and refrigerate until firm.
  12. If desired, decorate with sanding sugar or edible glitter before serving.

Tips

  • Use high-quality chocolate for the best flavor.
  • If the mixture becomes too soft to shape, chill it again before continuing.
  • For a flavored twist, add a teaspoon of liqueur such as raspberry or orange to the chocolate mixture.
